name: Civilization Readers
description: A mini-site of 32 museum primers covering the Mediterranean, Asia, Africa (kingdoms and peoples alike), the Americas, and Oceania. Each reader shows a visual timeline (with a world-history ruler), high-level context, deeper period-by-period detail, and a museum cheat sheet — including real Met gallery numbers. Routes for the Met, SF museums, and the Smithsonian are structured internally as a graph (museums → galleries → civilizations, plus relationship edges) and rendered as an interactive force-directed network on routes.html. Works offline, installable, and has a dark/low-light mode for dim galleries.
